title: LoReFT subspace + Mirror coordinate
hypothesis: A shared low-dimensional representation subspace plus per-task Mirror coordinates can store synthetic hidden-state interventions with lower actual bytes than independent LoReFT-style intervention vectors at matched intervention quality.
physical_object: one frozen synthetic 64D representation space and shared rank-4 intervention basis
mirror_coordinate: per-task four-dimensional coordinate, with optional low-bit codebook index
controls: shared basis plus quantized Mirror codebook coordinates

development.allowed: fit shared basis/codebook on development interventions and choose codebook size from {8,16,32,64} only

fresh.A0_excluded: serialized non-contiguous basis view included backing storage

success_gate: At some codebook setting, every fresh world has NRMSE <=0.05 and payload <=50% independent dense intervention bytes; compare FP16 LoReFT coordinates and report all application cost.
failure_gate: Quality/byte gate fails or shared FP16 LoReFT coefficients match/better Mirror at equal or fewer bytes; record private intervention need.
boundaries: Synthetic frozen representation space only; no pretrained Transformer, NLP or task-learning evidence.
This is storage/quality mechanism screening, not end-to-end LoReFT reproduction.
Logical task count alone is not capacity.

amendment_A1.reason: A0 serialized a non-contiguous SVD basis view backed by the full 64x64 singular-vector storage, inflating paid bytes. A0 retained as exploratory and excluded.
amendment_A1.change: Materialize the rank-4 basis contiguously before serialization; no quality or selection gate changes.
